results.title: Israel Warns Citizens in Greece as Gaza Genocide Protests Target Tourist Sites
results.description: Israel's Foreign Ministry has warned its citizens in Greece to conceal Jewish symbols ahead of pro-Palestinian protests explicitly framed as opposition to the Gaza genocide. The advisory comes as Israel announced 627 new West Bank settlement units on the same day.

results.title: 'There will be a Kiara before and after this film': Kiara Advani on playing Nadia in 'Toxic'
results.description: Kiara Advani reveals how Yash and Geetu Mohandas "manifested" her role as Nadia in the upcoming film 'Toxic: A Fairytale for Grown-Ups'. The trailer, packed with action and romance, drops major spoilers ahead of its August 26 release.

results.title: Assam Rail Passengers Association urges Centre to fast-track two railway projects in Assam
results.description: ARPA urges Centre to approve Sivasagar-Jorhat and Salona-Khumtai rail projects, seeking an alternative flood-resilient rail corridor in Upper Assam.

results.title: Houthis claim Saudi Aramco refinery attack; reports emerge of blast at Jubail gas facility
results.description: Yemen’s Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for a drone attack on Saudi Aramco’s Jazan refinery on Sunday, where Saudi authorities confirmed a fire but did not attribute it to the group.

results.title: Kharge, Rahul Gandhi Extend Greetings To Indian Youth Congress On Foundation Day
results.description: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Rahul Gandhi and K C Venugopal extended greetings to Indian Youth Congress members on the organisation’s Foundation Day. Leaders highlighted the IYC’s role in raising youth concerns, promoting young leadership and providing a platform for public service. The Indian Youth Congress was founded on August 9, 1960, as the youth wing of the Congress party.
